raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "study at"
  role subject "Otilia"
  role object "Colegiul Tehnic din Timișoara"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "be enrolled at"
  role subject "Olivia"
  role object "Colegiul Tehnic din Târgu Mureș"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "be based on"
  role subject "the reporting dashboard"
  role object "the VPN gateway"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "be based on"
  role subject "the analysis pipeline"
  role object "the email server"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "be on"
  role subject "Zeynep"
  role object "CS Galați"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s6 stated
  relation "be on"
  role subject "Yan Liu"
  role object "Șoimii din Brașov"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s7 stated
  relation "supply"
  role subject "Vertex Analytics"
  role object "Sistemele Nordwind"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s8 stated
  relation "buy from"
  role subject "Brightfield Foods"
  role object "Greenline Transport"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s9 stated
  relation "borrow"
  role subject "Vasile"
  role object "Ciorbele Transilvaniei"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s10 stated
  relation "borrow"
  role subject "Minh"
  role object "Ciorbele Transilvaniei"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s11 stated
  relation "borrow"
  role subject "Bogdan-Ionuț"
  role object "Ciorbele Transilvaniei"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "live in"
    role subject ?x
    role location "Buzău"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  except ?x "Lars"

@q2 query
  select ?y
  where match
    relation "coach"
    role subject ?y
    role object "CS Craiova"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  except ?y "Matei Moldovan"

@q3 query
  where match
    relation "borrow"
    role subject "Zoltán"
    role object "Ciorbele Transilvaniei"
    polarity negated
  end

@q4 query
  where match
    relation "depend on"
    role subject "the authentication service"
    role object "the inventory API"
    polarity affirmed
  end
